'''Charles Hunter''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Augusta tournament (20 August)]] on 20 August 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|Sabacc (starts TDIGWATT and Casino)]], according to Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1154">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-22-augusta-ga-8-20-00-longest-tr-everd1154/ augusta-ga-8-20-00-longest-tr-ever], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 22 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-22-augusta-ga-8-20-00-longest-tr-everd1154/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
